proposition.name: QuantumMachineLawfulAndConserved
proposition.text:
CircuitLinearAndAcyclic spec :=
  DistinctGateWires spec.steps = true
  /\ KahnTopologicalAcyclic spec.steps = true

QiskitTargetUnboundedValid cap n shots :=
  not cap = true /\ 1 <= n /\ 1 <= shots

ConservationLedgerValid state :=
  exactNormSquared Z[sqrt 2] state.support = state.normDenom
proposition.plain: Every admitted quantum circuit satisfies wire-linearity (no-cloning) and Kahn DAG acyclicity, Qiskit BackendV2 refuses contrived classical qubit caps, and sparse cyclotomic probability mass equals 1 identically without floating-point drift.
